text:
You need a full stack developer who can extend your Billing Management product with inventory, vendor, payment gateway, purchase/sales, Android API support, and stronger documentation while keeping the platform aligned with customer needs.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. Your project is the kind of work I like most: taking an existing product, refining it carefully, and adding the next layer of features without losing stability or clarity.

In a recent project, I built embedded usage dashboards for a confidential B2B SaaS product using React, TypeScript, Recharts, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. The goal was to give each customer account its own metrics inside the product. That rollout reached 140 customer accounts, and it was delivered 3 weeks early. That experience is relevant here because your Billing Management product will likely need new modules that fit naturally into the current workflow and data model.

I also built a multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics using Next.js, MDX, and Algolia. It launched in 4 languages and helped reduce support tickets by 27%. Since you mentioned proper documentation and other customer-driven features, I can help build documentation that is clear, maintainable, and useful for both your team and your users.

For your product, I’d focus on:
- adding new business modules in a clean, maintainable way
- designing REST API support for Android app development
- implementing payment flows with Stripe where appropriate
- improving documentation so future features are easier to ship
- keeping the UI consistent and responsive with React/Next.js/Tailwind CSS

I’m comfortable working across the stack, from UI and API work to database-backed feature development. If you want someone who can help bring structure to the next phase of this product and build features with long-term maintainability in mind, I’d be glad to discuss the scope and priorities with you.
